exposure: color Doppler pixel area near the bladder-uterine serosal interface on first-trimester transvaginal ultrasound
color pixel quantification near the bladder-uterine serosal interface
cohort: 54 pregnant women who underwent first-trimester transvaginal ultrasound
finding: Women requiring hysterectomy for PAS had a significantly higher color Doppler pixel area near the bladder-uterine serosal interface on first-trimester transvaginal ultrasound compared to women without hysterectomy or PAS.
